The 5 Simple Steps to Making Money Fast with Affiliate Marketing:

STEP 1: Sign up as an affiliate on any Affiliate Platform of your choice.

They’re affiliate marketing companies or platforms that have lots of digital products for affiliates to promote and earn commission in dollars, and they pay to their local bank account.

These companies allow you to register as an affiliate to promote and sell people’s digital products and earn a commission whenever someone buys from you.

For example, if a product costs $20 and pays 55% to people who promote it, when you sell it, you will earn $11.

Now this money goes straight into your affiliate account.

And when you place withdrawal, the platform pays your commissions directly into your local bank account.

You’ll even get an email about it, like this:

  • ✅ PromptEarn

STEP 2: Pick a HOT product from the product marketplace that people want to buy.

After signing up, you’ll see lots of digital products you can promote.

As a registered affiliate, you can promote any of them.

The most important thing is to pick a hot product that sells well and pays you good money.

STEP 3: Set up your WhatsApp sales funnel you’ll use for selling the product.

This is where the core marketing is done.

You will have to setup a sales funnel which you will use to get interested people online from social media handles and convert them to buyers easily at the end of the funnel.

Though, it requires some setup and systems to put in place and it also requires you to use your WhatsApp to talk to the interested persons.

Some affiliates use their personal WhatsApp number, but it’s usually better to use a new WhatsApp line to run the business.

In the AMB Program, you will be taught how to set up a WhatsApp sales funnel that will help you get people online and guide you on how to get them to buy the product you are promoting through the funnel.

STEP 4: Create offers around the product to get interested people to take action fast.

There’s a special way to do this. You can create seasonal or irresistible offers around the product you promote to get interested persons to make a swift buying decision to buy from you.

And how to create this kind of offer to get lots of people to buy from you as fast as possible will be taught extensively in the AMB Program.

STEP 5: Convert more people into buyers using the WhatsApp nurturing content and sales scripts.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a laptop to start?
No. A smartphone with WhatsApp on it and an internet connection is all you need to start. The whole business model is built around using just your phone.
Do I need prior experience?
No. The AMB Program is made for complete beginners, even if you’ve never sold anything online before. It has 5 short modules that take you step by step, and you can finish the training in a day and start using it.
Do I need to refer people before I earn?
No. You don’t earn by recruiting or referring people. As an affiliate, you promote digital products and earn a commission each time someone buys the product through you.
Will the AMB price increase soon?
It may. When the program launched in 2024 it sold for ₦6,000 ($6), then went up to ₦7,000 ($7), and it’s currently ₦15,000 ($15). The price may go up again anytime, so it’s best to register while it’s still available at ₦15,000.
How do I get customers to buy from me?
The program teaches you the exact process. You pick a hot product, attract interested people from social media and other places, then guide them through a WhatsApp sales funnel. You’ll also learn how to create offers that get people to act fast, and how to use nurturing content and sales scripts to close the sale.
Do I need to have a large social media following?
No. You don’t need a big following to start. The program shows you how to attract people who are interested in the product from social media and other places, and how to sell to them on WhatsApp.
